# `WorldApiMut::place_structure`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Places a registered structure using registry-driven layer collision checks.

## Signature

```rust
fn place_structure (& mut self , request : StructurePlacement ,) -> Result < Option < PlacedStructureId > , WorldApiError >
```

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/worldapimut-place-structure.md`](../../examples/methods/worldapimut-place-structure.md)_

```rust
let placed = world_mut.place_structure(StructurePlacement {
    kind: StructureKind::new("flux.default.structure.filter"),
    origin: UVec2::new(30, 12),
    rotation: StructureRotation::Deg90,
    params: StructureParams::None,
})?;
if let Some(id) = placed {
    println!("placed structure id {}", id.0);
}
```
